steps.text: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
So I'll finally have some free time
I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
Do you have anything that needs washing too?
Yeah, I have a few things
But are you sure you don't need help?
No, don't worry
You need to rest until you're fully healed
You're sure ?
Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
Thank you for everything you do
I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
Don't say that
You are not a burden
And none of this is your fault
You just need time to recover, that's all
After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
I'd love that
Then we'll do that
